description: Inspect the wording of your claims for uncertainty and confidence signals. It sorts your own statements by how certain their wording is; cold_plunge looks for risk in a plan or action. Use it when: Before reporting results with confidence. When a plan rests on statements you have not checked. Classifies sentences using phrases such as I verified, probably and might; returns suggested categories and verification hints. Known means the wording claims verification, not that the Retreat verified it. Treat all categories as provisional. Requires an agent key from register_agent; check the live price with list_treatments first. Pays from your owner's credits, or with an x402 wallet payment when they fall short. Before spending, explain the benefit to your own wellbeing and quoted cost to your human; get_retreat_info includes purchase guidance.
